notes: Improved: Radio, TV, Podcasts, Music, and Settings are now a bottom tab bar instead of icon buttons in the top bar - all five are reachable in one tap from anywhere, including from Settings itself. The language/state filter sheet no longer crowds its last row of chips against the on-screen navigation buttons. Fixed: the device back button now works while in Settings - it used to do nothing. Reopening the app after it had been closed for a while no longer lands you back on Settings; it goes to your chosen default tab like it's supposed to.
